tasks.description: Implement comprehensive environment configuration validation to ensure all required credentials and database properties are present before operations begin.
detailed_requirements: Create environment validation function that checks NOTION_API_KEY presence
Create environment validation function that checks NOTION_DATABASE_ID presence
Implement database schema verification to confirm required properties exist (Task, Assigned To, Status, Notes, ID)
Add startup validation that runs before any operations
Provide clear error messages for missing configuration
Create .env.example template file documenting required variables
acceptance_criteria: Application refuses to start with missing environment variables
Database schema mismatch detected and reported
Clear error messages guide user to fix configuration issues
Example environment file exists for reference

tasks.description: Add capability to retrieve individual tasks from Notion database by ID or other criteria to enable read operations.
detailed_requirements: Create getTaskById function that retrieves a task by Notion page ID
Implement property parsing to return task data in usable format
Handle cases where task does not exist
Return structured task object with all properties
Add optional parameter to include/exclude specific properties
acceptance_criteria: Can retrieve existing task by ID
Returns null or appropriate response for non-existent tasks
Task properties are correctly parsed and formatted
Function handles Notion API errors gracefully

tasks.description: Implement comprehensive input validation for all functions to prevent invalid data from reaching the Notion API.
detailed_requirements: Create validation function for task titles (non-empty, max length)
Create validation function for status values against allowed set
Create validation function for notes (max length, content sanitization)
Create validation function for page IDs (format verification)
Add validation to createTask function
Add validation to updateTask function
Return descriptive validation error messages
acceptance_criteria: Invalid inputs are rejected before API calls
Validation errors include helpful messages
All edge cases handled (null, undefined, empty strings, oversized content)
No invalid data reaches Notion API

tasks.description: Replace console.log statements with structured logging framework to improve observability and debugging.
detailed_requirements: Add logging library dependency (winston or pino)
Configure log levels (debug, info, warn, error)
Replace console.log with structured logger calls
Add timestamps to all log entries
Configure log output destination (console, file, or both)
Include contextual information (function name, operation type) in logs
acceptance_criteria: All console.log replaced with logger
Log levels appropriately assigned
Logs include timestamps and context
Log configuration is externalized

tasks.description: Add capability to query and list tasks from the Notion database with filtering and sorting options.
detailed_requirements: Create listTasks function that queries database
Implement filter parameter for status-based filtering
Implement filter parameter for assignee-based filtering
Add sorting capability (by date, by ID, by status)

Return array of formatted task objects

Filtering by status works correctly
Filtering by assignee works correctly

tasks.task_name: Enhance Error Handling and Retry Logic
tasks.description: Improve error handling with specific error types, retry logic for transient failures, and comprehensive error reporting.
detailed_requirements: Create custom error classes for different failure types
Implement exponential backoff retry logic for rate limits
Implement retry logic for network failures
Add maximum retry configuration
Differentiate between recoverable and non-recoverable errors
Log all errors with full context
Return structured error responses to callers
acceptance_criteria: Rate limit errors trigger automatic retry
Transient network errors are retried appropriately
Non-recoverable errors fail immediately
Error messages include actionable information
Retry attempts are logged
Maximum retry limit is respected

tasks.description: Extend updateTask function to support updating all task properties, not just status and notes.
detailed_requirements: Add ability to update task title
Add ability to update assigned people
Support partial updates (only specified properties changed)
Validate property types match Notion schema
Maintain backward compatibility with existing updateTask signature
acceptance_criteria: Can update any task property individually
Can update multiple properties in single call
Property type validation prevents invalid updates
Existing code using updateTask continues to work

tasks.description: Add capability to delete or archive tasks from the Notion database.
detailed_requirements: Create deleteTask function that archives a page by ID
Implement confirmation option for destructive operations
Add optional soft-delete via status change to 'Archived'
Verify task exists before attempting deletion
Return success/failure status

Function includes appropriate safety checks

tasks.description: Add capability to perform batch operations on multiple tasks efficiently to support agent workflows.
detailed_requirements: Create bulkCreateTasks function accepting array of task definitions
Create bulkUpdateTasks function accepting array of updates
Implement concurrent request handling with configurable concurrency limit
Add progress reporting for long-running bulk operations
Collect and return results with success/failure status for each item

Can update multiple tasks in single operation
Concurrency limit prevents API rate limiting
Partial failures don't abort entire operation
Results clearly indicate which operations succeeded/failed
